measurement.scan_rule: nearest native timestamp; earlier time on ties; keep actual timestamp
measurement.velocity_denominator: actual native elapsed time between selected endpoints
measurement.support: all native intermediate samples finite, observed, same run, strictly increasing time; no interpolation, gap fill or slot reassignment
measurement.invalid: d/u null with reasons and curve break; whole window unsupported
measurement.identity: opaque slot only; no person continuity certification

descriptive_metrics.mean_grid: all native timestamps in each interval, equal sample weights
descriptive_metrics.support: complete requested window and trailing history required

future_real_proposal_not_executable.selection: For each run, first multiple of 10 seconds with past .6 and future 1.5 inside run, then every 10 seconds. Both candidate teams symmetrically; no H/A or action labels. At most 100 times per match selected before support checks; no replacement after failures.
future_real_proposal_not_executable.cap: Sort eligible times by (run,time). If N <= 100 retain all; otherwise select indices floor(k*(N-1)/99), k=0..99. No backfill after support failures.
future_real_proposal_not_executable.slots_at_center: A nearest ball within candidate team; C distinct teammate nearest A; R opposing team nearest ball. Distance ties use stable slot key. Preserve slots for entire window.
future_real_proposal_not_executable.uniform_motion_control: Extrapolate from t with trailing velocities at t, same slots and common native support. Compare later velocity changes relative to pre and d_i(t); not a causal null or semantic validation.

matching.algorithm: Visit windows chronologically by (run,time), without replacement. Within identical bins select nearest Euclidean initial vector standardized by stated bin widths, different grid times only; distance ties (run,time). Report unmatched; no causal or semantic claim.
